payload_json.loop: Channel to charge weapon with fire. Release at timed window (Perfect Timing indicator) for 363-1132% attack damage fire wave at 0.2+ stats. In 0.1: always applied Ignite on hit, faster attack speed base (45% vs later 35%). The always-Ignite + high base speed = degenerate charge loop that was nerfed in 0.2.

raw_json.mech_note: mech_note: 'Hold to a PERFECT-TIMING window for a bonus fire hit — a rhythm-game flourish [without sufficient power premium].' conf=0.87 (well-known launch skill). Era=0.1 only — immediately recognized as weak. Same SMLSSW prefix as poe2-titan-hotg and poe2-smith-ignite — all are STR/melee/low/spiky/solo/wind-up Warriors; Perfect Strike was the under-powered member of that prefix family.
raw_json.why_negative: mechanic-too-narrow: Perfect Strike's rhythm-timing bonus (hold to timing window for bonus fire hit) was too small a power premium vs other Warrior skills; community abandoned it quickly after 0.1 launch

geometry_bands.source_anchor: channeled melee heavy-strike: channel to charge the weapon with Fire, then RELEASE with Perfect Timing (a skill-native timing indicator) to create a damaging wave of intense Fire in a forward melee arc. commit=wind-up, amp=spiky. In 0.1 (mapped era) it ALWAYS applied Ignite on hit and had 45% base attack speed -- the always-Ignite + fast base was the degenerate charge loop nerfed to 35% + conditional-Ignite in 0.2. burn ailment (always-Ignite, 0.1). Physical->fire conversion is the point. Forward arc + charged wave -> melee_arc (not ground_slam; fetched text is a forward WAVE, no downward quake).

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: negative=1 TRAP KIT mapped HONESTLY. The Perfect Timing window is SKILL-NATIVE (a built-in release beat), NOT a proc window -- R-M5 considered, not applicable (the accrual token is deliberately NOT emitted; whispering-ice precedent). PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime routes the always-Ignite DoT-uptime that WAS the trap (0.1 always-Ignite + fast base = permanent burn on a trivial loop); ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL routes the phys->fire slam. verify_ledger: era-0.1 UNSUPPORTED but negative_canon CONFIRMED (launch loop trivially degenerate; reworked by 0.2). GX-03.
